findings.title: Blind SSTI in /amortization endpoint allows flag extraction
findings.description: The /amortization?term= parameter is vulnerable to Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). The template engine evaluates expressions within { } syntax and uses the result as the term parameter. While {{ }} syntax causes errors, the { } syntax allows expression evaluation. Boolean-based blind SSTI techniques can be used to extract data character by character by checking conditional expression results against different row counts.

reproduction.expected: Response contains 60 rows (condition true), confirming the flag value
